_note: Safe, non-secret configuration. Every null value is PENDING client confirmation — see docs/content-gaps.md. Never put API keys or secrets in this file.

prototype._comment: true = client-review build (flags + pending-content blocks visible). Run `npm run build:clean` for a review build with flags hidden and pending blocks omitted.

logo._comment: Interim raster cropped from the supplied brand board. Replace with the original SVG / high-res transparent logo before production.

certifications._comment: Issuer, scope and certificate dates not supplied.

integrations._consentModeTypeNote: basic = GTM loads only after the visitor grants analytics or advertising consent (recommended default pending legal review). advanced = GTM loads immediately with all consent denied by default.

facilityManagement._comment: coming_soon | live. 'live' renders the full template, makes the page indexable, adds it to the sitemap and enables the proposal CTA. Only switch after content approval.

legal._comment: Set true only after client/legal counsel approve the final policy text. Controls Privacy page indexability and the draft notice.
